history.summary: 999-year D19 3BR (1,076sqft) at $1.58M / $1,468psf — the top algo score (MMR 827) but on a 17-unit micro-development with only 6 URA transactions, a 2.6% yield, and an unknown single-project developer. The headline 13.2%/yr CAGR is statistical noise; this is an illiquid boutique, not an investment-grade asset.
history.rating_rationale: Anti-anchoring is decisive here: MMR 827 and the 13.2%/yr 'appreciation' both derive from just 6 transactions across a 17-unit block — meaningless and not to be trusted. With only 17 units, exit liquidity is near-nil; a single motivated seller sets the market and price discovery is poor. Developer (Mushroom Realty) has built only this one project — no track record. Gross yield is a weak 2.6%. The 999-year tenure and 990m to the future Serangoon North CRL station (~2030) are real positives that prevent an Avoid, and $1.58M is an accessible entry. But for a 5-7yr investment hold, the illiquidity and unreliable data dominate — Neutral, low confidence. Not a 'buy on the score'.
red_flags: Only 17 units — severely illiquid, no meaningful resale market
6 URA transactions: 13.2% CAGR and MMR 827 are statistically meaningless
Single-project unknown developer (Mushroom Realty); weak 2.6% gross yield
catalysts: 999-year leasehold — effectively freehold, no lease decay
990m to future Serangoon North CRL station (~2030) — potential uplift
Accessible $1.58M entry near Kovan/Serangoon amenities and schools
